subject: Re: Kickoff: dot-product vs learned similarity for the recs scorer
body:
Reproduction status: ml-1m matches the published curves. With embedding dim 16, regularization 0.005, 8 negatives, learning rate 0.002 over 256 epochs, the simple MF model lands within 0.4 points of HR@10 of the learned-similarity baseline, and at dim 192 it's clearly ahead. Freya sees the same shape on pinterest-20 (reg 0.01, 10 negatives, lr 0.007). We repeat each config 8 times and report means, same as the paper.

Risk to flag: the reference NCF code assumes a Python 2 runtime, and Milan's port of the evaluation protocol found an off-by-one in how we'd been sampling the 100 negatives for the hit-rate metric. Fixed now, but it invalidated two weeks of early comparison numbers. Lesson: everything for the June memo runs through the ported evaluator only.

On track for the Vulcan week.

Carmen
